map_promotion_required.title: Floorplan upload needs recovery
map_promotion_required.description:
A floorplan upload was not confirmed. Vacuula demotes the old floorplan before uploading its replacement, so no-go lines and zones may no longer be active. Automatic and mapped cleaning from this integration are paused until recovery.

Check the saved boundaries in Vacuula. In Developer tools > Actions, run `vacuula.map_action` for this robot with the floorplan's `map_id` and `action: promote`. A confirmed promotion and status readback clear this notice. The integration does not retry robot commands automatically. Explicit whole-home cleaning without a map remains available. Existing robot schedules and controls outside Home Assistant are not blocked.
